AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS

ROLL CALL:

**ORAL COMMUNICATIONS**

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR MATTERS LISTED ON THE AGENDA (MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC) 

DISCUSSION: (Item 1)

1.. COVID-19 UPDATE (CITY COUNCIL) CM Landers gave a PowerPoint presentation on COVID -19 Impacts. 

City Clerk gave Disaster Council presentation. 

CM Landers spoke about the city's re-open plan. 

LDH requested staff look into car wash businesses reopening. 

Council member Hilton inquired about the City's ability to re-open amid the public health directives. AR directed CAO to prepare an analysis of how the city may re-open certain businesses in lieu of the County's Public Health Directive. 

Mike Whittaker gave a presentation on the COVID-19 Task Force. 

LDH inquired about if the people donating blood will be tested for COVID-19 as well. Staff addressed her question. 

Captain Skeen commended Mike Whittaker and the COVID-19 Task force for doing such a great job. In addition, he addressed the question about the emergency blood drive. 

Council member Dear commended the Task force for saving the life of a resident who was home alone when she fell and could not get up. 

Mayor thanked Captain Skeen and his deputies for their work in the community. 

City Attorney addressed Council member JH inquiry about city powers noting that generally cities are allowed to more restrictive, but will research whether or not city's can be less restrictive

John Raymond, Assistant City Manager gave a status report of the city's small business loan program. 

Discussion ensued between Council woman Lula Davis-Holmes and staff regarding an error in the recreation guide for the small business loan program. 

meeting adjourned at 6:16pm 




ORAL COMMUNICATIONS (COUNCIL MEMBERS)

ADJOURNMENT

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR MATTERS LISTED ON THE AGENDA (MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC)  City Clerk read oral communication. 

AR thanked Carson residents for their patience with the COVID testing. 

Discussion ensued between the City Council regarding rapid test results, residents who are concerned about not receiving their test results and the county's extended shelter in place order.
